source_title: 저렙존 학살하는 병신들 때문에 와우 망함.
subtitle: 20렙 학살하던 만렙 도적의 최후

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
만렙 달고 가시덤불 와서
20렙 쪼렙들만 학살하네…
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle jungle clearing shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy tropical fern floor touch. On the left, smug level-60 Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins) twirls her compact twin green daggers boastfully with a cocky grin. On the right, level-20 Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) glares disapprovingly with hands on her hips while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) frowns beside her.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
전쟁섭 낭만도 모르냐?
겁쟁이는 일반섭 가라!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle boastful shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal leafy ground touch. On the left, cocky Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed at waist) tilts her chin up smirking smugly with arms crossed and sparkling ego aura. On the right, level-20 Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) narrows her bright violet eyes sharply while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) puffs up indignantly beside her.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
동렙 못 이겨서 20렙 잡는
니가 진짜 겁쟁이 아니냐?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder confrontation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with crisp dramatic impact lines. On the left, fierce level-20 Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) steps forward pointing one empty finger straight ahead in a sharp callout while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) points fiercely alongside her. On the right foreground, Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) flinches stiffly with a giant sweat drop.

Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with tense vertical shock lines. In the center-left foreground, Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins) freezes in pure busted horror with tiny shocked dot eyes, pale face, and pouring cold sweat. Looming ominously directly behind her right shoulder, an actual level-60 Horde Orc Warrior glares down with gleaming crimson eyes and an intimidating battle grin.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
오 마침 동렙 얼라 발견!
도적아 정정당당하게 붙자!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile action shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy floor touch. On the left, pumped-up level-60 Horde Orc Warrior rests her battle axe on her shoulder beaming with fierce battle excitement and fiery red aura sparks. On the right, terrified Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) trembles stiffly with knocking knees and pale blue terror lines.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
동렙 뜨자마자 칼소멸 튀기…
누가 겁쟁이인지 딱 나왔네
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide slapstick comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal jungle grass floor touch and open pure #FFFFFF upper-right space (zero text or speech bubbles). On the left, unimpressed level-20 Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) crosses her arms with a dry deadpan stare while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) shakes its head beside her. On the lower-right, panicked Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) pops a crisp swirling Vanish smoke puff and sprints away frantically at full speed in a blur.

equip_effects: 전투 중 즉시 은신 상태가 되어 적의 시야에서 사라집니다.
